{
  "name": "zebra-mod",
  "version": "0.3.3",
  "description": "Turns Claude Code into a rare-disease research workstation: phenotype-driven diagnosis, variant interpretation (ACMG), sequence-to-function models, genotype-to-therapy, classical statistics — every answer anchored to live public databases.",
  "author": {
    "name": "zwbao",
    "url": "https://github.com/zwbao"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/zwbao/zebra-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/zwbao/zebra-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "rare-disease",
    "genomics",
    "hpo",
    "acmg",
    "variant-interpretation",
    "sequence-to-function",
    "bioinformatics"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "python": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Python",
      "description": "Python 3.9+ interpreter that runs the zebra CLI (standard library only)",
      "default": "python3"
    },
    "doctrine": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Research doctrine",
      "description": "Rare-disease research rules in the system prompt. auto: the full rules while a case is open, otherwise a short section that applies only to rare-disease questions (other work is untouched). always: the full rules in every session. case: only while a case is open. off: never.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "always",
        "case",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "privacyGate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Privacy gate",
      "description": "Refuse outgoing calls that carry the open case's protected identifiers or ID/phone/email patterns, and ask before files from the case folder or raw genome data leave the machine. With no case open, a pattern in another tool's call is asked about rather than refused.",
      "default": true
    },
    "interface": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Interface",
      "description": "How much zebra-mod shows in Claude Code. full: its own rows for its tool calls, the databases being queried in the spinner, a galloping zebra above the prompt while it queries, a shield after the privacy gate refuses a call, a footer label and a one-line summary at the end of a turn. quiet: the same without the animation and the spinner text. off: Claude Code's own drawing only.",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "quiet",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "full"
    }
  }
}
